summary: Added 9 committed regression tests at the two public boundaries T24R#F-004 named: 3 in src/mcp/structural-redaction.test.ts (secret property name, $ref-sibling refusal, entity/srcset auto-fetch vs public-link control) and 6 in src/security/persistence-sinks.test.ts (5 duplicate-member shapes from T24-recheck-f002-class.ts, plus the metric-beside-long-digit-run control). All 9 genuinely fail in a scratch-copy revert (21 pass / 10 fail, vs 31 pass / 0 fail on the real tree) and none required a production change. No production file was edited; no existing test was deleted or weakened.

acceptance.criterion: AC2 (AFC-02): synthetic secret is absent from JSON, text resource and error; safe JSON passes its schema; a numeric required field carrying a secret returns format-unsafe rather than an invalid string.
acceptance.evidence: New MCP property-name test asserts JSON.stringify(result) excludes the credential in payload and metadata for both a top-level and array-nested case; new duplicate-member persistence tests assert the credential is absent from prepareOutputForPersistence's materialized content in all 5 shapes; the existing numeric-secret transport test is untouched and stays green (216 pass, 3 skip, 0 fail wider run).

acceptance.criterion: AC5 (AFC-15): a mixed corpus of safe IDs and real secrets allows no field-name bypass; a URL secret is masked; a public Markdown link is not treated as a network send.
acceptance.evidence: New MCP test asserts entity-encoded and every srcset candidate are masked to [REDACTED:url] with reasons ['egress.html-image-exfil'], the attacker host is absent from the transported text, and the ordinary public Markdown link field in the same payload is byte-identical to the input.

acceptance.criterion: Every closure the two reviews demanded is pinned by a committed test at the boundary where the defect was reachable, not only at the pure validator; the full focused security and MCP selection stays green.
acceptance.evidence: bun src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test src/security/output-validation.test.ts src/security/detect/exfil.test.ts src/mcp -> 216 pass, 3 skip, 0 fail, 844 expect() calls, 219 tests across 20 files (.metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T14-01-58-957Z_run.log).
